definitions.explanation: Something that is seen; a visual scene or situation.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{光景|こうけい}
{目|め}の{前|まえ}の{光景|こうけい}に{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the scene before my eyes.

examples.japanese: {懐|なつ}かしい{光景|こうけい}
{戦争|せんそう}の{後|あと}、{町|まち}は{見|み}るも{無残|むざん}な{光景|こうけい}となり、{人々|ひとびと}は{言葉|ことば}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: After the war, the town became a pitiful sight, and people were left speechless.

notes:
{光景|こうけい} refers to scenes or sights.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {美|うつく}しい{光景|こうけい} (beautiful scene)
- {悲惨|ひさん}な{光景|こうけい} (tragic sight)
- 〜という{光景|こうけい} (the sight of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {光景|こうけい}: scene (literary, what is seen)
- {景色|けしき}: scenery (natural view)
- {風景|ふうけい}: landscape, scene
- {場面|ばめん}: scene (in a story/movie)
